name: wrong-move-alert-system
description: LMS Integration System with Wrong Move Alert for KAIST Touch Math Academy

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker-compose down && docker-compose build && docker-compose up -d
scripts.db:setup: psql -U postgres -f database/schema.sql && psql -U postgres -f database/seed.sql
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install

author: KAIST Touch Math Academy
